name: Tumbler
summary: A password field with a cut-away padlock whose five pins set, one per rule, until it clicks shut
about: A new-password field built around a brass padlock with a window onto its pin tumblers. Every rule you meet pushes one spring-loaded pin up to the shear line, the shackle drops a notch, and the meter and crack-time estimate update as you type. Meet all five and the key turns, the shackle slams shut with sparks, and Save turns green.
how: Type a password: each of the five rules you meet sets one pin and lowers the shackle a notch
Watch the strength meter and the estimated time to crack it; common words, your name and runs like 123 keep pin 5 down
Press the eye to show or hide it, or Suggest one to type in a random strong password
With all five pins set the lock clicks shut; press Save password or Enter to save it
